description:
Create a 'polite' crawling profile for a fragile client site. 

STEPS:
1. Open Screaming Frog SEO Spider.
2. Configure Speed: Go to Configuration > Speed. Set 'Max Threads' to 1 and 'Max URLs/s' to 2.0. Take a screenshot of this dialog and save it to '~/Documents/SEO/reports/speed_settings.png'. Close the dialog.
3. Configure User-Agent: Go to Configuration > User-Agent. Select 'Custom' and enter 'AuditBot 1.0'. Take a screenshot of this dialog and save it to '~/Documents/SEO/reports/ua_settings.png'. Close the dialog.
4. Save Profile: Go to File > Configuration > Save As... and save the file to '~/Documents/SEO/configs/polite_profile.seospiderconfig'.
5. Test Crawl: Enter 'https://books.toscrape.com/' and start the crawl. Wait until at least 20 URLs are crawled, then pause/stop.
6. Export Data: Export the 'Internal HTML' data to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/polite_crawl_data.csv'.
